description: Field-level encryption in Cribl Stream, decrypted natively in Cribl Search (replaces the Splunk cribldecrypt workflow). Pipeline encrypt_pii extracts social / cardNumber / accountNumber / userName from business_event-style events, overwrites the three PII fields with C.Crypto.encrypt(value, 1) (key class 1, key auto-selected from this Worker Group), and masks the same values inside _raw. Decrypt in Cribl Search with decrypt(field, "<workerGroup>").
name: vct-field-encryption
